title: MS60019: Mechanical And Thermal Behaviour Of Polymers
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: None
Elastic, viscoelastic and flow behaviour of polymers, theory of linear
viscoelasticity, creep and stress relaxations in polymers, super position
principle and time-temperature equivalence, stress-strain behavior of polymers
and the dependence of stress-strain curve on internal and external factors,
plastic behaviour of polymers, concept of forced elasticity and zarkov
relation, fatigue and life time of polymers, fracture of polymers, principles
of reinforcement in polymers, strengthening mechanism in polymers. Thermal
transitions in polymers, glass rubber transition (Tg) and flow transition (Tf),
melting of crystalline polymers, thermal degradation, thermal expansion in
polymers, theory of thermal conductivity and specific heat of polymers, thermal
transitions in polymers, thermogravimetry, differential scanning calorimetry,
thermomechanical behaviour and analysis.
